hero.subject: a Malaysian batik craftsman hand-painting a colourful floral batik design onto stretched cloth at a batik centre in Kuala Lumpur
hero.alt: A batik artisan leaning over a length of white cloth stretched on a frame, using a fine brush to hand-paint vivid red hibiscus-style flowers with green leaves and gold outlines, in a workshop hung with photographs

body.subject: a close-up of hand-drawn Malaysian batik fabric from Terengganu showing a large red flower outlined by white wax-resist lines
body.alt: A close-up of batik cloth showing a bold crimson flower with fine white wax-resist outlines and dotted detailing set against a deep indigo-blue background

body.subject: lengths of colourful patterned Malaysian batik fabric displayed on racks at a craft carnival in Terengganu
body.alt: Many lengths of batik fabric hung in rows, in rich reds, purples, pinks, greens and oranges, each printed with different floral, leaf and geometric wax-resist patterns

hero.subject: Thean Hou Temple, Kuala Lumpur, under a canopy of red Chinese New Year lanterns
hero.alt: Hundreds of red-and-gold lanterns strung in radiating lines beneath the ornate roofs of Thean Hou Temple in Kuala Lumpur against a clear blue sky during Chinese New Year

body.subject: Kek Lok Si Temple in Penang illuminated for Chinese New Year

body.subject: Lion dance performed on poles in Kuala Lumpur's Chinatown during Chinese New Year
body.alt: A white and silver lion dance costume balanced atop poles performing outside shophouses in Kuala Lumpur's Chinatown during Chinese New Year

hero.subject: Deepavali kolam ringed by lit oil lamps in Malaysia

body.subject: Hanging Deepavali lanterns and festive crowds at KL Sentral station
body.alt: Rows of bright yellow decorative Deepavali lanterns hanging above a busy concourse of travellers at KL Sentral station in Kuala Lumpur

body.subject: Large peacock-themed floor kolam at KL Sentral for Deepavali

hero.subject: An ornate yellow dragon boat with carved dragon head and tail crewed by paddlers at a waterfront in Sandakan, Sabah

body.alt: Rows of paddlers in red caps and white shirts digging their blades into the water as two canopied dragon boats race along a channel watched by a crowd

body.alt: A bamboo-leaf-wrapped glutinous rice dumpling unwrapped to reveal savoury filling of braised pork belly, chestnut and salted egg yolk, next to a tied dumpling

hero.subject: red-lacquered Malay gasing spinning tops wound with cord, displayed on batik cloth at a Malaysian cultural showcase
hero.alt: Two disc-shaped Malay gasing tops of red-lacquered wood, each tightly wound with white launching cord, resting on a carved black box and a vivid purple-and-gold batik cloth, with a plain heavier gasing beside them

body.credit: Steven from Dallas, Texas, USA / Wikimedia Commons
body.subject: two newly wood-turned Malay-style gasing spinning tops with their launching pegs
body.alt: Two pale, freshly turned wooden gasing tops with the classic flat disc body and raised central knob, lying on a bed of wood shavings beside their smooth cylindrical launching handles in warm sunlight

body.subject: a young competitor launching a gasing by its cord at a traditional spinning-top contest
body.alt: A boy in an orange tracksuit leans forward as he hurls a spinning top from a long white cord onto a wooden board, a spun top already resting on the plank while a crowd of onlookers watches closely behind him

hero.subject: An Iban dancer performing the ngajat warrior dance

body.subject: Dayak performers in full regalia at the Gawai Dayak parade in Kuching
body.alt: Iban and Orang Ulu performers in elaborate silver headdresses, beadwork and feather crowns during the Gawai Dayak parade in Kuching, Sarawak

body.subject: The communal gallery of an Iban longhouse in Sarawak
body.alt: The long wooden communal gallery (ruai) inside an Iban longhouse in Sarawak, where Gawai Dayak is celebrated

hero.subject: Worshippers in festive baju Melayu after Eid prayers at a village mosque in Perak
hero.alt: Crowds in festive baju Melayu leaving a twin-minaret village mosque after Aidilfitri morning prayers in Alor Pongsu, Perak

body.subject: Ketupat palas with beef rendang, a classic Hari Raya dish
body.alt: Woven palm-leaf ketupat palas rice packets beside a plate of beef rendang, a classic Hari Raya Aidilfitri dish in Malaysia

body.subject: A lit bamboo pelita oil lamp at night during Hari Raya

hero.subject: A brightly lit getai stage with red neon and an LED display at a Hungry Ghost Festival performance

hero.subject: Kadazan-Dusun bobohizan performing a Kaamatan ritual dance in Penampang, Sabah

body.subject: The Unduk Ngadau winner and finalists at the Kaamatan festival pageant
body.alt: The Unduk Ngadau winner crowned among six finalists in traditional black-and-gold Kadazan-Dusun costume on stage at the Kaamatan festival in Penampang, Sabah

body.subject: Kadazan-Dusun youths performing a harvest-festival dance with gongs
body.alt: Young Kadazan-Dusun dancers in black costume with red and silver trim performing a traditional dance with gongs at a Kaamatan harvest celebration in Sabah

hero.subject: a Malay keris with a gold-worked wavy blade and carved hilt displayed above its ornate silver-chased sheath

body.subject: a collection of royal Malay keris with ornate silver bird-head hilts associated with the Johor-Riau Sultanate
body.alt: Several antique royal keris stood upright in a dark museum case, their long engraved silver scabbards topped by finely cast bird-head hilts, lit so the metalwork gleams against the shadowed background

body.subject: the Keris Alang of Pahang, a ceremonial keris of chiefly authority, laid beside its wooden sheath
body.alt: A straight-bladed ceremonial keris with a dark carved hilt lying beside its long slender wooden scabbard on a pale surface, with a museum caption card reading KERIS ALANG PAHANG below them

hero.subject: an illuminated lantern sculpture and lantern display at a Mid-Autumn (Mooncake) Festival at a temple in Selangor, Malaysia
hero.alt: A large glowing silk lantern sculpture of a smiling man in a purple jacket and red trousers holding up a blue-and-yellow globe lantern at night, with rows of red and gold hanging lanterns lit up along a walkway behind him during a Malaysian Mid-Autumn celebration

body.subject: freshly baked jade-rabbit mooncakes, the signature food of the Mid-Autumn Festival
body.alt: Rows of golden-brown baked mooncakes pressed with jade-rabbit and floral motifs laid out to cool on a perforated metal tray, their glossy pastry tops catching the light

body.subject: a traditional red concertina paper lantern of the kind children carry during the Mid-Autumn Festival
body.alt: A round red accordion-folded paper lantern printed with white stars and a rabbit silhouette, hanging in front of green foliage and pink flowers, the classic collapsible paper lantern children carry at Mid-Autumn

hero.subject: a pewtersmith at Royal Selangor in Kuala Lumpur hammering the surface of a pewter tankard held in a jig
hero.alt: A woman artisan in a purple headscarf and apron bends over a workbench, tapping a small hammer against a pewter tankard mounted on a steel jig, with rows of pewter mugs behind her

body.subject: a Malaysian pewter worker turning a tankard on a lathe, with finished pewter tankards arranged on the bench
body.alt: A pewter craftsman using a tool against a tankard spinning on a lathe, metal shavings curling off, with about nine polished silvery pewter tankard bodies grouped on the wooden workbench

body.subject: a finished, polished pewter tankard with a handle
body.alt: A single polished pewter tankard with a chunky handle and horizontal banding, its mirror-like silvery surface catching the light against a pale background

hero.subject: traditional horseshoe-shaped Chinese ancestral graves on the hillside of Bukit Cina, Melaka, Malaysia
hero.alt: A large grey stone Chinese grave with a curved omega-shaped surround and a red-tiled worshipping court sits on a grassy hilltop at Bukit Cina in Melaka, with a separate dome-topped earth-god tomb nearby and a passer-by walking among the trees

body.subject: a spread of food offerings and burning incense laid before a grave during Qingming tomb-sweeping
body.alt: A grave offering table laid with whole steamed chickens, fish, roast pork, bowls of white rice with chopsticks, cups of tea and teapots, with bundles of red incense sticks planted upright in gourds and burning before a stone shrine

body.subject: a gilded guardian-lion grave pillar inscribed with Chinese family names at the Chinese Cemetery (Bukit Cina) in Melaka, Malaysia
body.alt: A gilded stone guardian lion perches on top of a granite grave post carved with gold Chinese characters, set against a grassy burial mound and a spreading tree under an overcast sky at the Bukit Cina Chinese cemetery in Melaka

hero.subject: a close-up of a Malaysian songket hip-wrapper from Terengganu, densely brocaded with gold-metal-wrapped thread on red silk
hero.alt: A detailed close-up of handwoven songket cloth, deep red silk covered in dense floral and diamond motifs brocaded in glinting gold thread, with a contrasting central panel

body.subject: a full Malaysian songket hip-wrapper (kain) from Terengganu laid flat, showing the gold-brocade field and central head panel
body.alt: A complete rectangular songket cloth displayed flat, two red side panels of gold-thread floral motifs flanking a lighter gold central panel

body.subject: a tanjak, a folded Malay headdress made from gold songket cloth, from Terengganu
body.alt: A folded triangular Malay headdress (tanjak) made of green-gold songket cloth that shimmers with woven metallic thread, displayed on a stand

hero.subject: Devotees climbing the colourful steps to the Temple Cave at Batu Caves during Thaipusam
hero.alt: Devotees climbing the rainbow-painted stairway of Batu Caves toward the ornate cave-temple shrine beneath towering limestone cliffs during Thaipusam

body.subject: Crowds of Thaipusam pilgrims below the golden Lord Murugan statue at Batu Caves
body.alt: A dense crowd of pilgrims filling the walkway at Batu Caves below the towering golden statue of Lord Murugan and the forested limestone hills during Thaipusam

body.subject: A kavadi bearer carrying a milk pot in the Thaipusam procession in Ipoh
body.alt: A Thaipusam devotee seen from behind shouldering a bell-hung kavadi pole and carrying a silver milk pot before a colourful Hindu temple gopuram in Ipoh, Perak

hero.subject: a large decorated wau bulan (crescent moon kite) displayed at the Pasir Gudang Kites Museum
hero.alt: A big ornately decorated wau bulan kite mounted on a pale wall, its broad crescent-shaped body covered in shimmering gold, pink and blue foil floral patterns with a fringed tassel at the top and a label reading WAU BULAN beneath it

body.subject: a close-up of the intricate cut-paper and foil floral decoration on a Kelantan wau
body.alt: Macro view of a wau's surface showing hand-cut floral and leaf motifs in iridescent turquoise and gold foil outlined in black against a dark paper ground, with a magenta blossom at the lower right

body.subject: finished wau bodies and a bare bamboo wau frame in a kite-maker's workshop
body.alt: Inside a wooden workshop, several completed wau panels patterned in pink, gold and teal foil hang beside a slender bamboo kite frame strung with taut cords, with the maker partly visible at a table in the background

hero.subject: a flower-decked Buddha statue on a Wesak Day festival float at Alor Setar, Kedah, Malaysia
hero.alt: A golden seated Buddha statue draped with yellow marigold garlands sits before a brightly coloured orange, blue and gold aureole on a festival float, surrounded by banks of white, yellow and pink chrysanthemums under an awning during Wesak Day in Alor Setar

body.subject: rows of colourful devotee blessing lanterns with good-wish slips at a Wesak Day celebration in Alor Setar, Malaysia
body.alt: A long row of small hanging lanterns in turquoise, lime green, pink and white, each holding a lit candle and a pink paper slip of good wishes, strung up under a tent at a Malaysian Wesak Day celebration with visitors walking behind

body.alt: Hundreds of tiny lit lotus-shaped candle lamps laid out in neat rows across pink and yellow cloth-covered tables, leading up to a small Buddha statue flanked by flowers against a painted blue-sky backdrop inside a tent

hero.subject: Colourful tang yuan glutinous rice balls in sweet ginger syrup served in a white bowl for the Winter Solstice
hero.alt: A white bowl of pastel pink, purple and yellow glutinous rice balls floating in clear sweet syrup with a blue-rimmed ceramic spoon resting in it

body.subject: Close-up of translucent crystal-skinned tang yuan in white, purple and green floating in a bowl of syrup
body.alt: A close bowl of glossy, semi-transparent glutinous rice balls in white, lilac and jade green bobbing in clear sweet soup

body.subject: A bowl of purple glutinous rice balls in hot syrup, seen from above with rising steam
body.alt: Top-down view of four plump purple tang yuan glutinous rice balls in clear hot syrup in a blue-rimmed bowl, wisps of steam rising
